sentences.text: Welcome, welcome, welcome to this match. This match will take exactly 18 minutes, okay?
sentences.translation: 晚上好，晚上好！你们好吗？很好！欢迎，欢迎，欢迎来到这场比赛。这场比赛将整整持续 18 分钟，好吗？

sentences.text: And are all part of the same team, mechelin okay? Hey guys, I would like to see fair play on the field, respect and positivity.
sentences.translation: 而且你们都属于同一支队伍——梅赫伦队。好的。嘿，各位，我希望在场上看到公平竞赛、尊重和积极，

sentences.text: Is that okay for everyone? Cool. Good luck.
sentences.translation: 这对大家来说可以吗？酷。祝你们好运。

sentences.text: One year ago, I decided I wanted to become a football referee, not because of the money, though.
sentences.translation: 一年前，我决定成为一名足球裁判。不是因为钱——

sentences.text: I only get paid 20 euros per much so I won't really get rich by it, will I?
sentences.translation: 我每场比赛只能拿到 20 欧元，所以我靠它可发不了财，对吧？

sentences.text: No, I decided to become a referee for two other reasons.
sentences.translation: 不，我决定当裁判是出于两个原因：

sentences.text: One, to stay in good shape.
sentences.translation: 第一，保持好身材；

sentences.text: Two, because I wanted to learn how not to take things personally.
sentences.translation: 第二，因为我想学会如何不把别人的话往心里去。

sentences.text: I can see some people nodding, are probably thinking being a referee is the perfect environment to learn how not to take things personally, isn't it?
sentences.translation: 我看到有些人在点头。你们大概在想，当裁判是学习“不往心里去”的绝佳环境，不是吗？

sentences.text: Because the spectators hardly ever shout encouraging or positive things, no. well do they shout? Come on, come on.
sentences.translation: 因为观众几乎从不喊鼓励或积极的话，不是吗？他们喊的是：“上啊，上啊！

sentences.text: Loser, are you blind? Yeah, yeah, good.
sentences.translation: 你瞎了吗？！”是的。

sentences.text: As a referee, I'm the scapegoat. Apparently, I'm always wrong. It's always my fault.
sentences.translation: 作为一名裁判，我是那个替罪羊。显然，我总是错的，永远是我的错。

sentences.text: And I wanted to learn how not to take all this personally, because I really struggle with this.
sentences.translation: 而我想学会如何不把这一切往心里去。因为我在这方面真的非常挣扎。

sentences.text: For example, when I drive slowly, because I'm trying to find a specific location, and somebody is just thriving behind me, I feel hunted, especially when they start honking and flashing their headlights.
sentences.translation: 比如，当我开得很慢，是因为我在找某个具体位置，而后面有人拼命催我时，我会感到被追击，尤其是当他们开始按喇叭、闪大灯时。

sentences.text: I take it personally. I know, I shouldn't. But it just happens. Do you see what I mean?
sentences.translation: 我会把它往心里去。我知道我不该这样，但它就是会发生。你们明白我的意思吗？

sentences.text: Yeah, oh when somebody cancels an appointment last minute, I get the feeling that I'm not important enough.
sentences.translation: 是的。哦，当有人在最后一刻取消约会时，我会有一种“我不够重要”的感觉。同样地，

sentences.text: Again, I take it personally, even professionally.
sentences.translation: 我又把它往心里去了。甚至在职业上也是如此。

sentences.text: I'm a public speaker, like tonight, this is what I do, I give keynote speeches, and I really like it as long as I can draw my audience into my story.
sentences.translation: 我是一名公众演讲者，就像今晚，这就是我的工作。我做主题演讲，而且我真的很喜欢——只要我能把观众带进我的故事里。

sentences.text: Because the very moment I see somebody is not paying attention, for example, when somebody is looking at his smartphone, it just happens.
sentences.translation: 因为一旦我看到有人没有在专心听，比如有人在看手机，它就会发生——

sentences.text: I take it personally.
sentences.translation: 我又往心里去了。

sentences.text: I relax. You are safe tonight. Don't worry. Feel free to take your smartphones, and you can even start talking to your neighbor.
sentences.translation: 放松，你们今晚很安全，别担心。尽管拿出你们的手机，你甚至可以开始和邻座聊天，

sentences.text: I will not take it personally. Why not?
sentences.translation: 我不会往心里去。为什么不会？

sentences.text: Because now, here and now, I'm very conscious that this can happen, and more importantly, I have a strategy to deal with it.
sentences.translation: 因为此时此刻，我非常有意识地知道这种情况可能发生。而更重要的是，我有应对它的策略。

sentences.text: So tonight, I would like to share this strategy with you. Are you interested? Cool.
sentences.translation: 所以今晚，我想把这个策略分享给你们。你们感兴趣吗？酷。

sentences.text: Because I guess I'm not the only person in this room who sometimes takes things personally, right?
sentences.translation: 因为我猜，在这个房间里，我并不是唯一一个有时候会把事情往心里去的人，

sentences.text: Imagine you invite a friend to go to the movies, and she replies, oh, sorry, I have to work.
sentences.translation: 对吧？想象一下：你邀请一位朋友去看电影，她回答说：“哦，抱歉，

sentences.text: But you see a picture on social media of her having dinner with some friends. that very night.
sentences.translation: 我得工作。”但你却在社交媒体上看到她当晚和几个朋友在吃晚饭的照片。

sentences.text: Or imagine, you really have worked very hard on a project. You're really proud of the end result, but the only thing you get is criticism.
sentences.translation: 或者想象一下：你真的很努力地做了一个项目，你对最终成果非常自豪，但你得到的唯一回应却是批评。

sentences.text: So you come home, and you would like to going down and share this terrible experience.
sentences.translation: 于是你回到家，想倒头睡一觉，跟人倾诉这段糟糕的经历。

sentences.text: But while you're telling your story, the other one walks away to switch on the TV.
sentences.translation: 可就在你讲的时候，对方却走开去打开了电视。

sentences.text: Now, who would take one of these situations personally? Show me hands. Come on.
sentences.translation: 现在，谁会把这样的情形往心里去？举手给我看看。

sentences.text: Lots of you.
sentences.translation: 你们中的很多人。

sentences.text: Why? Why do we take things personally? Somebody says or does something, and bam, we feel hurt, neglected or offended betrayed by the other one.
sentences.translation: 为什么？我们为什么会把事情往心里去？某人说了或做了某件事，然后“砰”，我们感到受伤、被忽视、被冒犯、被背叛。

sentences.text: That's what we believe, though. It's the other person's fault. is responsible for what we feel. is the one to blame.
sentences.translation: 我们相信，是对方造成的，是他的错，他要为我们所感受的负责，该怪罪的是他。

sentences.text: Now, hang on. Hang on. Who says that? Which part of us is speaking? It's our ego.
sentences.translation: 现在，等一下，等一下。谁说的？是我们内在的哪一部分在说话？是我们的“自我”。

sentences.text: Our ego thinks that others should take us into consideration.
sentences.translation: 我们的自我认为，别人应该考虑到我们。

sentences.text: Our ego doesn't want to be criticized. Hell no. Our ego wants to be acknowledged. I'm right.
sentences.translation: 我们的自我不想被批评，才不呢。我们的自我想要被认可。“我是对的。”

sentences.text: Is this what you want? Do you want to be right? That's exhausting.
sentences.translation: 这是你想要的吗？你想证明自己是对的？那太累人了。

sentences.text: When my ego takes over, I'm fighting all day. I'm in a constant struggle with the rest of the world, and it drains my energy.
sentences.translation: 当我的自我掌权时，我整天都在战斗，我持续地与整个世界较劲，这会耗尽我的精力。

sentences.text: Wouldn't it be so much easier to not take things personally? Because then, no one has power over you.
sentences.translation: 如果能不把事情往心里去，会不会轻松得多？因为那样，就没有人能掌控你。

sentences.text: You are free. You experience much more harmony and connection between you and other people.
sentences.translation: 你是自由的。你会在自己和他人之间体验到多得多的和谐与连接。

sentences.text: Of course, because your energy can go towards nice things instead of endlessly battling against the things that drive you crazy.
sentences.translation: 当然，因为你的精力可以投向美好的事，而不是无休止地和那些让你抓狂的事对抗。

sentences.text: So the question is, do you want to be right? Or do you want to be happy?
sentences.translation: 所以问题是：你是想证明自己是对的，还是想快乐？

sentences.text: I know what some of you are thinking. I will make sure I will be happy by being right.
sentences.translation: 我知道你们中有些人在想：我会确保自己快乐——通过证明自己是对的。

sentences.text: Well, how do you do it? How to become happy by not taking things personally?
sentences.translation: 那么，你该怎么做？如何通过“不往心里去”而变得快乐？

sentences.text: You are standing at the kick kickoff of the much of your life, the match by which you will learn how to stop taking things personally.
sentences.translation: 你正站在你人生这场“比赛”的开球点上——通过这场比赛，你将学会如何停止把事情往心里去。

sentences.text: So as a referee, I brought my coin for the task And every coin has two sides, heads or tails, and they stand for two strategies.
sentences.translation: 作为一名裁判，我为这个任务带来了我的硬币，而每一枚硬币都有两面：正面或反面。它们代表两种策略，

sentences.text: Two strategies to no longer taking things personally.
sentences.translation: 两种不再把事情往心里去的策略。

sentences.text: Sir, sir, good evening. You you're the captain of this huge thing you can choose. Heads or tails.
sentences.translation: 先生，先生，晚上好，你是这支庞大队伍的队长。你可以选正面或反面。好的，

sentences.text: Okay. You're lucky. its hats Are you ready for the first strategy? Okay. Here comes. First strategy. It's not about me.
sentences.translation: 你运气不错，是正面。你准备好听第一个策略了吗？好的，来了。第一：这不关我的事。

sentences.text: What do you mean it's not about me? This sounds weird, doesn't it? Because when I take things personally, I'm convinced it is about me.
sentences.translation: 你什么意思，“这不关我的事”？这听起来很怪，不是吗？因为当我把事情往心里去时，我坚信它就是关于我的。

sentences.text: When I see someone is looking at his phone, I feel offended. I think, hey, I've put so much effort and time in this presentation.
sentences.translation: 当看到有人在看手机时，我感到被冒犯，我想：“嘿，我花了这么多精力和时间在这个演讲上，我要被尊重。

sentences.text: I want respect, I think, me, myself, and I. Sounds familiar, no? Yeah. But in fact, it isn't about me.
sentences.translation: ”我想的是“我、我、我”——听着耳熟吧？是的。但事实上，这不关我的事。

sentences.text: What if I try to look at it from the other person's perspective asking myself, why? Why is he or she looking at his or her smartphone?
sentences.translation: 如果我试着从对方的角度看问题，问问自己：“为什么？他或她为什么在看手机？”

sentences.text: Maybe he has just received an important message, one he has been waiting for.
sentences.translation: 也许他刚收到一条重要的消息，一条他一直在等的消息。

sentences.text: Or the topic of my presentation is not really his cup of tea. It could be.
sentences.translation: 或者，我演讲的主题不是他的菜。也有可能——

sentences.text: On the contrary, he finds it very interesting and he wants to take notes on his smartphone. Very smart to do that, by the way.
sentences.translation: 恰恰相反，他觉得很有趣，想用手机记笔记。顺便说，这是很聪明的做法。

sentences.text: I simply need to shift my focus from me to we, and I won't take it personally.
sentences.translation: 我只需要把焦点从“我”转移到“我们”，我就不会往心里去。

sentences.text: If I try to see the intention of the other one, I make space for understanding instead of irritation.
sentences.translation: 如果我试着去理解对方的意图，我就在为理解腾出空间，而不是恼怒。

sentences.text: Does this ring a bell with you? When you put your son to bed, but he doesn't want to he throws himself on the floor kicking and screaming, I hate you!
sentences.translation: 这有没有让你想起什么？当你哄儿子上床，他却不肯，摔倒在地、又踢又叫：“我讨厌你！”

sentences.text: Do you take that personally? No! No, you don't, because you know this is not about me. It's about what he wants, what he needs.
sentences.translation: 你会把这句话往心里去吗？不，你不会，因为你知道，这不关我的事，这是关于他想要什么、需要什么。

sentences.text: He's angry because he just wants to say it up a bit longer. That's all. So the first strategy to not take it personally is it's not about me.
sentences.translation: 他生气，只是因为他想再晚睡一会儿，仅此而已。第一个策略，不把它往心里去——这不关我的事，

sentences.text: Look at the other person's intention. When a driver is still tailgating and flashing his slides, he probably does it because he's in a hurry.
sentences.translation: 去看对方的意图。当一个司机在追尾、闪大灯时，他这么做，很可能只是因为他赶时间。

sentences.text: It's not about me. You see? It's as simple as that. In theory, because in real life it turns out to be a hell of a job.
sentences.translation: 这不关我的事。你看，就这么简单。理论上是这样。因为在现实生活中，这其实是一件极其困难的事。

sentences.text: Do you have any idea, ladies and gentlemen, how many thoughts our brain produces a day?
sentences.translation: 女士们先生们，你们知道我们的大脑一天会产生多少个念头吗？

sentences.text: Thousand And guess how many of them are positive? Only thousand So this means eighty percent of what we think all negative thoughts. That's a lot, isn't it?
sentences.translation: 五万个。猜猜其中有多少是积极的？只有一万个。所以这意味着，我们所想的 80% 都是消极的念头。这可不少，对吧？

sentences.text: When you see two colleagues talking to each other, and just then they look at you and they start laughing, do you think, oh, they must have noticed my new shoes and they want them to?
sentences.translation: 当你看到同事们聚在一起说话，恰好这时他们看向你，然后开始笑。你会想：“哦，他们一定是注意到我的新鞋了，他们也想要一双。”

sentences.text: Now, what do you think, darn, they're laughing at me, they're gossiping about me?
sentences.translation: 还是会想：“糟了，他们在笑我，他们在说我闲话。”所以，

sentences.text: So it takes a lot of effort to correct yourself and say, hang on, I have no clue. They might be laughing about something that has nothing to do with me.
sentences.translation: 纠正自己需要很大的努力——要告诉自己：“等等，我毫无头绪，他们可能在笑某件跟我毫无关系的事。”

sentences.text: So seeing the positive intention of the other one requires a lot of discipline and training.
sentences.translation: 所以，看到对方的积极意图，需要大量的自律和训练。

sentences.text: And that's why I became a referee to train my brain not to take things personally.
sentences.translation: 而这就是我成为裁判的原因——训练我的大脑不把事情往心里去。

sentences.text: I train my brain an hour and a half a week. The entire period of a match, I said is for the football dummies.
sentences.translation: 我每周训练我的大脑一个半小时，也就是一场比赛的全部时长。我说这是给“足球小白”的。

sentences.text: And now, before the match, I'm warming up. Not only physically, but also mentally. I give myself some pep talk in into dressing room.
sentences.translation: 现在，在比赛之前，我不仅做身体上的热身，还做心理上的热身。我在更衣室里给自己打气：“弗雷德里克，

sentences.text: Frederick, watch out. Lots of things will trigger you during the game. You're going to make decisions who some will not agree with, and they will shout and unpleasant things at you.
sentences.translation: 小心，比赛里会有很多事触发你。你会做出一些决定，有人会不同意，他们会朝你喊难听的话。”

sentences.text: So I tell myself, Frederick, don't take it personally. It's not about me. They just want to be right.
sentences.translation: 所以我告诉自己：“弗雷德里克，别往心里去。这不关我的事。他们只是想证明自己是对的，

sentences.text: They simply want their team to win. You see, when I focus on the intention of the other person, there is no need to take it personally.
sentences.translation: 他们只是想让自己的球队赢。”你看，当我专注于对方的意图时，就没有必要往心里去。

sentences.text: When I apply this strategy very consciously, I admit it, I feel much more at ease on the field. When the coach, the players or the spectators do not agree with my decisions, I'm less easily thrown off balance.
sentences.translation: 当我非常刻意地运用这个策略时——我承认——我在场上会感到自在得多。当教练、球员或观众不认同我的判罚时，我不那么容易失去平衡。

sentences.text: This strategy, ladies and gentleman works. Not always, unfortunately, because some words they at me like, here, do really hit a roll nerf.
sentences.translation: 女士们先生们，这个策略，有效。但不总是有效，遗憾的是。因为他们朝我喊的有些话，确实戳中了痛处。“

sentences.text: You're a loser. Choose another hobby. You know what? Go fishing. couch.
sentences.translation: 你是个失败者，换个爱好吧，你知道吗？去钓鱼吧，教练。”

sentences.text: Maybe they are right. Perhaps I took the wrong decision. Maybe I am a loser.
sentences.translation: 也许他们是对的。也许我真的做错了决定，也许我真的是个失败者。

sentences.text: Honestly, that's how I feel sometimes. You see this. Every coin has a flip side.
sentences.translation: 老实说，我有时候确实会这么觉得。你看，每枚硬币都有反面。

sentences.text: When this first strategy, it's not about me. Doesn't work. It simply means it is about me.
sentences.translation: 当第一个策略“这不关我的事”不起作用时，那只意味着——这确实关我的事。

sentences.text: I have to look in the mirror and question myself. As a beginning referee, I still feel insecure, especially me. I never played soccer.
sentences.translation: 我得照照镜子，质问自己。作为一名新手裁判，我仍然感到不自信。尤其是我，我从没踢过足球。

sentences.text: It is about me because it has something to do with my insecurity. I doubt about myself or a part of myself that I haven't come to terms with.
sentences.translation: 这确实关我的事，因为它和我内心的不安全感有关，我怀疑自己，或者是我内心深处某个尚未与自己和解的部分。

sentences.text: Do you see my points ladies and gentlemen? Even if I know that a driver is only tailgating because he's in a hurry, I still take it personally when he hungs or he's flushing his headlights.
sentences.translation: 你们明白我的意思吗，女士们先生们？即使我知道那个司机追尾只是因为他赶时间，当他按喇叭、闪大灯时，我依然会往心里去。所以我必须质问自己：

sentences.text: So I must question myself. Probably I was driving too slowly. I'm aware of it. I just don't like that clumsy part of myself. Why else would I take it personally?
sentences.translation: 也许我开得太慢了。我意识到了这一点，我只是，只是不喜欢自己那个笨拙的部分。否则我为什么会往心里去呢，

sentences.text: When I say, ladies and gentlemen, you are an orange. Who would take this personally? No one. Why not? Because nothing in you believes that you are in fact an orange, an orange.
sentences.translation: 对吧？当我说：“女士们先生们，你是个橙子。”谁会把这句话往心里去？没有人，对吧？为什么不会？因为你内心深处没有任何东西相信你真的是一颗橙子。

sentences.text: Unless, of course, that you are a ginger and you feel bad because of that, which is luckily not the case with me. But when someone says, fredric you are so selfish.
sentences.translation: 除非你刚好是红头发，而且因此感到难过，幸好我不是这种情况。但当有人说：“弗雷德里克，你太自私了。

sentences.text: Ouch, I do take it personally. And it only happens because I know there is some tooth in it, if from honest.
sentences.translation: ”哎哟，我确实会往心里去。而它之所以会发生，是因为我知道这句话里有几分真实。坦白说，

sentences.text: I'm aware of the fact that I do not always take into account other people's needs.
sentences.translation: 我意识到，我确实不总能把别人的需求放在心上。

sentences.text: When you are being criticized and it hurts, chances are big that this is rooted in your childhood.
sentences.translation: 当你被批评、并且它刺痛你时，很可能这植根于你的童年。

sentences.text: Maybe as a child, you were never good enough. When you came home with a nine out of 10, they said, hey, and why another 10?
sentences.translation: 也许小时候，你永远不够好。当你考了 10 分里的 9 分回家，他们却说：“嘿，那另外1 分呢？”

sentences.text: You see, you can only take things personally if it somehow touches a roll nerf And that's the moment to give yourself some empathy.
sentences.translation: 只有当某句话以某种方式戳中了你的痛处时，你才会把它往心里去。而那正是该给自己一些同理心的时刻。“

sentences.text: Oh this hurts, dan I'm longing so hard for recognition. And I feel sad if I don't get it.
sentences.translation: 哦，这很痛。我如此渴望被认可，如果得不到，我会很难过。”你看，

sentences.text: You see? And you can also, why not? Speak up. Just tell the other one what's going on inside you.
sentences.translation: 你还可以——为什么不——直接说出来，告诉对方你内心正在发生什么：

sentences.text: Hey, I'm in the middle of my story here and you just walk away to switch on the TV.
sentences.translation: “嘿，我故事正讲到一半，你却走开去打开电视。

sentences.text: It feels as if you don't care about my story. It's not nice.
sentences.translation: 这让我觉得你不在乎我的故事。这让人很不舒服。”

sentences.text: By opening up, by being vulnerable, by telling what you feel without blaming the other one, you increase the chance that the other one will understand you and take your needs into account.
sentences.translation: 通过敞开心扉、展现脆弱、说出你的感受而不指责对方，你就增加了对方理解你、并把你的需求考虑在内的可能性。

sentences.text: You see what I mean? To conclude, how not to take things personally?
sentences.translation: 你们明白我的意思吗？总结一下，如何不把事情往心里去：

sentences.text: One, it is not about me. Look at the other person's intention. If that doesn't work, two, it is about me. Give yourself empathy and speak up.
sentences.translation: 第一，这不关我的事——去看对方的意图。如果这不管用，第二，这确实关我的事——给自己一些同理心，并说出来。

sentences.text: Ladies and gentlemen, please, pretty please do not take it personally, but I really do hope that you will take a couple of things personally within the next hours and days.
sentences.translation: 女士们先生们，求求你们，别把这句话往心里去，但我真的希望，在接下来的几个小时和几天里，你们能把一些事情往心里去。

sentences.text: Only if you do, you can test out these two strategies. Imagine. Just imagine.
sentences.translation: 只有这样，你才能检验这两种策略。想象一下，

sentences.text: We could all, if we could all put this in practice, wouldn't that enhance our relationships enormously?
sentences.translation: 如果我们都能把它们付诸实践，那会不会极大地改善我们的人际关系？

sentences.text: Together we could create a better world. would that be great?
sentences.translation: 我们一起就能创造一个更美好的世界，那该多好。

sentences.text: And as a referee, I even earn some money by it. Who would also like 20 euros to learn how not to take things personally? Show me hands.
sentences.translation: 而作为裁判，我甚至还能靠这个赚点钱。谁也想要这 20 欧元、去学会如何不把事情往心里去？举手。

sentences.text: Show me hands. Oh, so many.
sentences.translation: 举手。哦，这么多人。

sentences.text: Who stay wants a twenty euros now?
sentences.translation: 谁还想要这 20 欧元？

sentences.text: Who still wants the to years now?
sentences.translation: 现在，谁还想要？

sentences.text: Who still wants the to years now?
sentences.translation: 现在，谁还想要？

sentences.text: And who still wants them now?
sentences.translation: 谁现在还想要？

sentences.text: Why do you still want these 20 euros?
sentences.translation: 你们为什么还想要这 20 欧元？

sentences.text: People may attack you, criticize you, or ignore you. They can crumple you up with their words, spit you out, or even walk all over you.
sentences.translation: 人们可能会攻击你、批评你，或者无视你。他们可以用言语把你揉皱，把你吐掉，甚至从你身上踩过去。但请记住：

sentences.text: But remember, whatever they do or say, you will always keep your value.
sentences.translation: 无论他们做什么或说什么，你永远要保持自己的价值。

sentences.text: Thank you.
sentences.translation: 谢谢，

sentences.text: Thank you.
sentences.translation: 谢谢。

clips.summary: 讲者欢迎大家来到这场「18 分钟的比赛」，大家都属于梅赫伦队。一年前他决定当足球裁判，不是为了钱——一场才 20 欧元——而是为了保持身材，以及学会如何不把别人的话往心里去。

keyPoints.phrase: Welcome, welcome, welcome to this match
how not to take things personally
synonyms: how not to take it personally
how to stop taking things personally

clips.summary: 观众几乎从不喊积极的话，而是喊「你瞎了吗」。作为裁判，他是替罪羊，显然永远是他的错。而他想学会不把这一切往心里去，因为在这方面他真的非常挣扎。

keyPoints.phrase: the spectators hardly ever shout encouraging or positive things

clips.summary: 他举了几个「往心里去」的例子：开车慢被催、被人按喇叭闪大灯；约会最后一刻被取消；演讲时看到有人看手机。他明知不该这样，却还是会发生。
但今晚你们很安全，因为他现在非常有意识地知道这种情况可能发生，更重要的是，他有应对策略。所以今晚他想把这个策略分享给大家。

keyPoints.phrase: I have a strategy to deal with it
synonyms: I have a strategy to handle it
I have a way to cope

keyPoints.phrase: I'm very conscious that this can happen
synonyms: I'm very aware this can happen

clips.summary: 他让大家想象：邀请朋友看电影被拒，却发现对方当晚和别人吃饭；辛苦做的项目只换来批评；倾诉时对方却走开去开电视。他问谁会把这样的事往心里去——很多人举了手。

keyPoints.phrase: you see a picture on social media
synonyms: you see a photo on social media
you see it on social media

keyPoints.phrase: the only thing you get is criticism
walks away to switch on the TV
synonyms: walks away to turn on the TV
walks off to switch on the TV

keyPoints.phrase: take one of these situations personally

clips.summary: 为什么会往心里去？某人说或做了某事，我们感到受伤、被背叛，并相信是对方的错。说话的其实是我们的「自我」——自我希望被考虑到、不想被批评、只想被认可，想证明「我是对的」。

keyPoints.phrase: we feel hurt, neglected or offended
synonyms: we feel hurt, ignored or offended

keyPoints.phrase: Our ego wants to be acknowledged
synonyms: the ego wants to be validated

clips.summary: 不把事情往心里去会轻松得多，因为那样就没人能掌控你，你就自由了，还能把精力投向美好的事。所以问题在于：你是想证明自己是对的，还是想快乐？

keyPoints.phrase: no one has power over you
do you want to be right
synonyms: do you want to be right
do you want to be right or happy

keyPoints.phrase: How to become happy by not taking things personally
synonyms: how to be happy by not taking things personally
how to stop taking things personally

clips.summary: 作为裁判，他带来了硬币——每一枚都有正面和反面，代表两种不再把事情往心里去的策略。他请观众选正反面，结果是正面，于是他开始讲第一个策略：「这不关我的事」。

synonyms: each coin has heads or tails

clips.summary: 「这不关我的事」听起来很怪，因为往心里去时我们坚信就是关于自己。看到有人看手机，他本能想的是「我、我、我」。但如果从对方角度想，也许对方刚收到重要消息，或者想用手机记笔记。

keyPoints.phrase: look at it from the other person's perspective
he has just received an important message
synonyms: he just got an important message
note it down on his phone

clips.summary: 把焦点从「我」转到「我们」，理解对方的意图，就不会往心里去。就像哄儿子上床时他喊「我讨厌你」，你知道这跟你无关，他只是想多玩一会儿。所以第一个策略就是：去看对方的意图。

keyPoints.phrase: shift my focus from me to we
synonyms: focus on we instead of me

keyPoints.phrase: make space for understanding instead of irritation
synonyms: make room for understanding, not irritation

keyPoints.phrase: Look at the other person's intention

clips.summary: 大脑每天产生五万个念头，其中只有一万个是积极的，也就是说 80% 都是消极的。看到同事笑，你容易想「他们在笑我」。看到对方的积极意图需要大量自律和训练——这正是他当裁判的原因。

keyPoints.phrase: how many thoughts our brain produces a day
synonyms: how many thoughts our brain produces daily
how many thoughts we have a day

keyPoints.phrase: eighty percent of what we think
a lot of discipline and training

clips.summary: 他每周训练大脑一个半小时（一场比赛）。赛前他做心理热身，在更衣室给自己打气：别往心里去，这不关我的事。这个策略有效，但不总是有效——当有人说「你是个失败者」，那确实戳中痛处，可能意味着「这确实关我的事」。

keyPoints.phrase: train my brain an hour and a half a week
synonyms: train my brain 1.5 hours a week
train my mind 90 minutes a week

clips.summary: 这确实关他的事，因为它触及内心的不安全感——他从没踢过足球，怀疑自己。就像说「你是个橙子」没人会在意，除非戳中你相信的东西；说「你太自私」会痛，是因为里面有几分真实。被批评刺痛时，可能源于童年；这时该给自己同理心，并说出来。
总结：第一，这不关我的事——看对方的意图；第二，这确实关我的事——给自己同理心并说出来。他希望大家在接下来几天真的去检验这两个策略，改善人际关系，共创更美好的世界（他甚至还能赚到 20 欧元）。最后：无论别人做什么说什么，你永远要保持自己的价值。

keyPoints.phrase: take a couple of things personally
Give yourself empathy and speak up
synonyms: give yourself empathy and speak up
show yourself empathy and say it

keyPoints.phrase: you will always keep your value
